title: Ambient restriction Fourier coefficient
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $f$ be a real-valued function on the sign cube $\\{\\pm1\\}^n$, let $J,S\\subseteq\\mathrm{Fin}(n)$, and let $z$ assign signs to the coordinates outside $J$. Define the ambient restriction Fourier coefficient at $S$ and $z$ to be the restriction Fourier coefficient at the free-frequency part of $S$ when $S\\subseteq J$, and $0$ otherwise.
